oracle.derivation: ngspice's RCA3040 differential amplifier example. Only the transient plot is replaced; the other plots stay ngspice-44.2 values, which Xyce 7.10.0 confirms within 0.617x their tolerance. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 99.8x its tolerance off it.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 4e-11
